# Harmonia

> Harmonia connects businesses with a global workforce for AI data annotation, model evaluation, human feedback (RLHF), moderation, and transcription tasks, while helping contributors earn online and work from home.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://harmoniaportal.online/): Overview of Harmonia's mission and services.
- [About](https://harmoniaportal.online/about.html): Company story, mission, and impact.
- [How It Works](https://harmoniaportal.online/how-it-works.html): How the annotation/evaluation workflow operates for workers and clients.
- [Contact](https://harmoniaportal.online/contact.html): Ways to reach the Harmonia team.
- [FAQ](https://harmoniaportal.online/faq.html): Frequently asked questions.
- [Help Center](https://harmoniaportal.online/help-center.html): Support resources for workers and clients.
- [Trust & Safety](https://harmoniaportal.online/trust-safety.html): Platform safety and integrity practices.

## Notes

Logged-in dashboard pages (admin, worker, client, reviewer) are intentionally excluded from crawling and indexing — see /robots.txt.
